chassis.detail: Forward, backward, left and right motion agreed independently in both lidars; clockwise and counter-clockwise directions were physically observed; final commanded velocity returned to zero.

command_validity_stop.detail: The command-gap stop is accepted. Reconnection after a transport failure remains a separate unaccepted behavior.

lidar_geometry.detail: Official frame geometry plus four physical translations produced at most 5.918 mm registration residual. Precision manipulation geometry is not included.

arm_motion.detail: Joints 1-4 physically moved during hand-eye validation. Joint state is still a command estimate, so physical attainment is not measured.

hand_eye.detail: Maximum physical validation error was 5.621 mm and 1.684 degrees for joints 1-4. Images acquired while a command is executing remain invalid.

localization.detail: SLAM, map storage and live pose work, but relocalization after physical displacement and autonomous navigation acceptance are not recorded.

arm_feedback.detail: Factory robotio reports no measured six-joint pose; the host stores the last completed command estimate.

gripper.detail: No accepted aperture calibration or successful retained-object grasp record exists.

pick_and_deliver.detail: Blocked by localization/relocalization and gripper acceptance; command acknowledgement is not counted as a grasp or delivery.
